about.text: Ryazhenka or ryazhanka, is a traditional fermented milk product in Ukraine, Russia, and Belarus. It is made from baked milk by lactic acid fermentation.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The long baking browns the milk through the Maillard reaction and boils off water, so the milk is already caramel-flavoured and cream-coloured. Thermophilic streptococci then sour it to a mild, thick drink; households seed it with smetana instead.
